entry_points.text: Cpu/boot hooks: departure drains reclaim/lock/cache refreshing thresholds, arrival refreshes; early init builds per-zone caches, clears empty-NUMA boot stats, allocs online-node stats, inits deferred release.

Control/idle: table exposes free minima, boost/scale, defrag, fraction, reserves, NUMA order/unmapped/slab with parsers/bounds; idle read clamps pos-to-frames reporting still-idle sets, write clears refs marking idle on set bits, misaligned rejected, beyond-max handled.

Hotplug/contig entries: builds on going-online with errors, ignores going-offline, tears down on offline-done/cancelled-online else no-op; exact/counted contig reject compound outwardly guaranteeing referenced success.

exports.text: Bulk, frozen, node, folio, direct, zeroed, nolock alloc: bulk fills array reporting new takes; frozen untracked, sibling tracks; missing node uses running node with offline check; folio compounds; direct excludes highmem; zeroed clears; nolock pins current node sleepless.
Release helpers: grouped contiguous with scheduling courtesy, lockless single, null-tolerant but validating address free, sized walk to aligned end, frame-range free warning on compound heads.

Contiguous alloc: frozen range validates, isolates, drains, migrates, handles huge, extracts, optionally compounds; range wrapper rejects compound and references frames; search walks zonelist for aligned single-zone candidates with fast then huge-aware passes.

Buddy poison, predicates, clean reclaim: take splits containing block around target marking taken; put returns at zero refcount; predicates test managed zones and buddy containment; clean helper sidelines clean file folios, guarded-shrinks, splices survivors fixing isolated counts.
Extension lookup/hold: frame/page/phys to side record with online check for phys, plus acquire under read guard and null-tolerant release.
Fragment cache and rmap walk: drain/low-drain/aligned-alloc/single-free on packed handle with bias/offset; walk iterates one range reporting each target-span mapping, completion helper drops locks.

hazards.text: Fallbacks/errors: single-remainder/controller/page-owner/headroom-less bulk yields at most one page; unmasked bits, oversize orders, undersized fractions are errors; dumps only with relocation debug plus warnings enabled, busy feeds isolation trace.

Racy/advisory: unlocked buddy probe advisory; ext needs read guard plus null handling incl early; compound needs exact align/pow2; poison needs zero ref; oversize frag fails keeping cache, reuse avoids atomic reset while shared; walk resamples/restarts treating splits as leaf; frag release asserts ref; bitmap misaligned rejected, beyond-max read empty/write fail.

invariants.text: Order and placement: oversize rejected; nolock needs cacheable order, trial lock, no deferred-growth sleep; contig allows only io/filesystem/reclaim plus small set deriving compaction mask; candidates need online same-zone movable frames, last frame in zone; free credits whole block, splits keep target half.

Exact, reserved, frozen-split: exact covers with power-of-two, drops compound/highmem, keeps leading referenced returning tail to order-zero; reserved checks align/order, clears tags/counts/marks, grows managed total, frees frozen; frozen leaves order-zero, expands higher in address order.

Clean select and migrate retry: only clean non-dirty evictable non-huge file folios lacking movable ops shrink after active clear, survivors spliced with file/anon counts fixed; migrate cacheless, isolates when queue empty else retries with clean reclaim first, aborts on interrupt, fails on repeated busy/exhaustion restoring caches.

Extension presence/boot: null/flagged means absent; entry from node-relative frame rounded to max block scaled by runtime size, null-tolerant base; early enable and lazy/eager acceptance are build defaults with boot opts; ops from optional features, size/usage global.

Section teardown: idempotent, invalid markers normalized before clear/free of section-start entry; release adjusts census then returns virtual storage or validates non-reserved backing, detaches leak track, frees exact bytes.

Fragment backing/drain: refill prefers large reclaim-limited tolerant page if platform page small else single, empty on fail; drains subtract caller/cached bias freeing by compound order only at zero, empty is no-op, handle cleared.

Idle sampling: only online head reclaim-list folios surviving recheck after get; per-mapping clears young at leaf/huge, consults device notifiers, marks young/not-idle on youth, subpage promotes huge; exposed as mode 0600 bitmap group page_idle.

Rmap match: huge uses single-attempt walk needing caller file lock and span check; migration flag selects present/device vs migration acceptance, transparent-huge present rejects migration; success on span overlap via leaf/huge spans; skip rounds up saturating wrap to max.

Tunables/cache: writes parse bounded then rebuild watermarks, unmapped/slab minima, staged reserves or all-zone fractions; zonelist accepts only leading D/N else warns/fails; cache flag set when per-cpu share exceeds 3x batch else cleared over populated zones.

locks.text: Alloc locks: bulk trial-takes pcp cache nonblocking, diverting on fail, releasing before fallback/after batch; contig scan holds zone lock irq-saved but drops across sleeping reserve; poison take/return scoped; post-isolation extraction lockless.
Cache-info locks: retention flag under non-pinning pcp lock; fraction writes under mutex, reads lockless as torn reads harmless.

Side/idle/walk locks: section reads single-access under read guard warning on miss, acquire holds, release drops; idle uses nonblocking folio plus shared anon lock; walk holds huge/middle/leaf per level, drops across tables, revalidates middle after leaf.

state_machines.text: Bulk/frozen flow: bulk skips partition/remote zones, tests low reserve plus missing with acceptance/growth retries else single-page; on hit takes zero-order mobility entries init/marked stopping if emptied; frozen validates, augments lockless, normalizes, builds ctx, fast then slow-reclaim, charges/frees with hooks.

Contig pipelines: reserve validates, isolates, drains, migrates tolerating busy, releases huge, finds outer bounds, verifies, extracts then splits to order-zero or prepares compound, always unisolating; search tries zones/offsets validating/attempting each, optionally huge-aware retry, first head or null.

Reclaim/offline: clean selects, guarded-shrinks, splices survivors fixing isolated counts; offline moves per-cpu events to survivor, clears departed diffs, atomically merges zone/node deltas to globals.

Section/fragment lifecycles: online expands to sections initing in order with prefix rollback on fail; offline expands marking invalid, drains readers, clears/frees; aligned alloc refills if empty, aligns carving with bias/offset or recycles via bias-drop/reserve-replace/exclusive-reset then retries fresh.
Walk descent: skips absent levels aligning forward, handles huge at middle, else maps leaf scanning entries/boundaries to first match or end.

structs.text: Boot/node state: per-node load int array to node limit; per-cpu boot caches/stats for pre-setup/empty zones; boot high 0 batch 1; order control max 16 bytes default Node.

Context/flags: ctx zonelist/mask/preferred/migratetype/highest (bounds reserves/reclaim/compaction); fallback FOUND/EMPTY/NOCLAIM; DEFAULT 0, MIN/LOW/HIGH alias, NO_WATERMARKS 4, MASK 3, OOM 8/alias, NON_BLOCK 16, MIN_RESERVE 32, CPUSET 64, CMA 128, NOFRAGMENT 256/0, HIGHATOMIC 512, NOLOCK 1024, KSWAPD 2048, NO_CODETAG 4096, RESERVES=NON_BLOCK|MIN_RESERVE|HIGHATOMIC|OOM; MOVABLE=reclaimable|movable shift 3, PAGE_EXT_INVALID 1.

Fragment handle/nolock: one word packs page-aligned addr plus low-bit order plus reserve flag with extractors/page derivation; nolock implies warn-suppress, zero-fill, no emergency reserves, compound grouping.
Idle unit: one 64-bit word, bits bytes-times-8; positions/lengths must align to it.
